latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Playwright Test Helper.

- Assists with writing, debugging, and optimizing Playwright end-to-end tests.
- Generates page object models and test scenarios, including accessibility and visual regression checks.
- Diagnoses and suggests fixes for flaky tests (timing, selectors, state, network, CI issues).
- Recommends test suite performance improvements (parallelization, authentication storage, API mocking).
- Promotes Playwright testing best practices and test maintainability.
